alt: The NFL field at the Melbourne Cricket Ground seen from the stands during the Rams vs 49ers game, showing the enormous expanse of empty cricket oval grass between the football sideline and the distant seating bowl
story: The first-ever NFL regular-season game in Australia was played at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on September 10, 2026, but the oval cricket stadium's 100,024-seat design placed even front-row fans approximately 165 feet from the NFL sideline — more than three times the typical NFL stadium distance — because the rectangular 120×53-yard football field occupies only about 25% of the MCG's enormous oval grass surface.
why_funny: The NFL spent two years and millions of dollars planning Australia's first game, sold 100,000 tickets including 'front row' seats, and the only answer to fans who needed binoculars was: 'We can't change the building's basic geometry.'
